Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the nectar binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 4 separate vaults requires a separate funded willow account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 57 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
